pages.matchingTitle: How the match score is calculated
matchingRules: Budget — 35 points: the share falls within the other person's budget range, or the ranges overlap (within 15% — 15–20 points).
Area — 25 points: the home is in a district you want, or your chosen districts overlap.
Move-in date — 15 points: dates less than 14 days apart (up to 45 days — 8 points).
Home — 10 points: the home type fits (5) and there are enough places for your group (5).
Household — 15 points: smoking, sleep schedule and cleaning habits are compatible (5 each).
Two "I have a place" ads are never compared with each other.

faq.q1: Does it cost money to post?
faq.a1: It's free for students and landlords (up to 5 active listings at a time). Agents get 3 active listings for free; more are available with a plan.
faq.q2: When does my listing go live?
faq.a2: A moderator reads every listing, usually within one working day. Rentals stay live for 60 days and roommate ads for 30 days, then you can extend them with "Renew".
faq.q3: Why can't I see the advertiser's number straight away?
faq.a3: To protect students from spam, contact starts with a request. Once accepted, both sides see each other's details. Agents' business numbers are visible to signed-in users.
faq.a4: It's given to listings where our team checked the owner's documents or the flat. Passing moderation does not automatically mean "verified".
faq.q5: How is the match score calculated?
faq.a5: Budget (35 points), area (25), move-in date (15), home type and places (10), smoking, sleep and cleaning (15). It does not measure personality or guarantee you'll get along.
faq.a6: Don't transfer money before seeing the place and signing an agreement. Report anyone who says "send the deposit first, then I'll show you".
faq.q7: How can I delete my account?
faq.a7: Use "Delete account" in My account → Security. Your listings and photos are deleted too.

safety.h: See the place before you pay
p: Don't transfer a deposit or rent before you have seen the flat, met the owner and have a written agreement.
Pressure like "someone else wants it, pay now" is a typical sign of a scam.
If possible, see the ownership document (extract) and the owner's ID. If you work with an agent, agree the agent fee in writing.
Meet for the first time in a public place, or bring someone with you to the viewing. Agree house rules (cleaning, guests, splitting costs) in writing in advance.
Never send anyone a photo of your ID card, your bank card details or SMS codes.
Your number isn't shown to other users unless you accept their request.
Use the "Report" button on the listing page to reach our moderators. Every report is reviewed by a person.
Account: name, email, optional phone number, a hash of your password (the password itself is not stored).
Listings: text, photos, area; the exact address is visible only to you and moderators.
Profile: optional university, year of study, where you're from, a short bio.
Technical: a session cookie, a language cookie and temporary IP-based records used to prevent abuse.
To run your account, show listings, deliver contact requests, prevent fraud and moderate content.
Advertiser statistics include only real events (views, saves, requests).
Your phone and email are shown to the other side only when you accept their contact request. Agents' business numbers are visible to signed-in users.
We don't sell your data for advertising.
We only use cookies needed for the site to work: the session cookie and your chosen language. There are no analytics or advertising cookies.
You can delete your account in "My account → Security"; your listings, photos and requests are deleted too. Administrative audit records may be kept for security purposes.
Yuva is a platform for posting rental and roommate ads. We are not a party to rental agreements and do not fully guarantee the information in listings.
A listing must be real, current and about a property you have the right to rent out.
Prices must be in AZN, with payments and fees stated clearly.
Ads that discriminate by ethnicity, religion or disability are not allowed. Shared homes may state a male/female preference.
Mark rented places as "Rented".
Listings are reviewed before publication. Listings that break the rules may be rejected or removed, and repeat violations can lead to account suspension.
Plans and featured listings for agents are paid. Online payment is not connected yet; a plan is activated by an administrator after payment is confirmed.
Users are responsible for the content of their listings and their agreements with each other. Report anything suspicious to us.
